647-751-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3755-4770-5295-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1912-3755-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3755-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3585-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4247-5170-6132-6634.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5330-6595--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5330-6595--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

2021-2060-4565-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

364-1987-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-1987-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-1987-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1770-3821-3859.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}.
1770-3821-3859.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying its mana cost.
When Cavern Harpy enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3617-4243-4423.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Mystic Sanctuary using Venser, the Sojourner.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.
3617-4243-4423.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Time Walk if it's able to do so.

3446-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
3446-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

1020-2510-2866-4659.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1020-2510-2866-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

1115-1563-3899-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2060-4929-5652-7061.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Solid Ground
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

2854-3518-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-3518-4574-6650.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2173-3944-5220-5332.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

5078-6259-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2292-2577-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

643-1636-3301.notablePrerequisites:
Tezzeret has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1636-3301.description:
Activate Tezzeret's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing Maskwood Nexus to become an artifact creature.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1555-2034-3374.notablePrerequisites: Phantom Nishoba does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1555-2034-3374.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Phantom Nishoba persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantom Nishoba, adding {C}{C}.
When Phantom Nishoba dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its first ability.
Repeat.

3750-3973-4214.notablePrerequisites:
Rith does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Rith.
There are at least eight permanents of any particular color on the battlefield.
3750-3973-4214.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Resolve the Rith ability, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
 If there are at least nine permanents of any particular color on the battlefield, this combo will net infinite creature tokens and colored mana.

243-628-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

914-2292-3249.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2292-3249.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

868-2670-2713-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter for {1}.
Splice Desperate Ritual onto Psychic Puppetry for {1}{R}, and have Psychic Puppetry target Isochron Scepter.
Resolve the spell, untapping Isochron Scepter and adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat as necessary, using {R} to pay for the Isochron Scepter activation and {R}{R} for Desperate Ritual.
